headline: OJK Speaks Out on Reports Prabowo Called MSCI Boss
summary: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) responded to reports of a conversation between President Prabowo and the MSCI CEO. It said no official confirmation exists but that it is monitoring the situation.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, overseeing banks, capital markets and non-bank lenders. Its statements shape investor perceptions of market governance.
original_headline: OJK Buka Suara soal Kabar Prabowo Telepon Bos MSCI
